about_short_description.short_description: CTERA enables enterprises to securely sync, share, protect and govern files from any device or office, all from the cloud of their choice.

product.name: CTERA Enterprise File Services Platform
product.description: An edge-to-cloud file services platform for centrally managed file storage, synchronization, sharing, backup, governance, and collaboration across distributed offices and users.

product.name: CTERA Portal
product.description: A centralized cloud management and file-services application for administering users, teams, endpoints, Edge Filers, policies, storage, and data access.

product.name: CTERA Edge Filer
product.description: A cloud-connected file server and storage gateway that provides local file access, caching, backup, synchronization, cloud tiering, and disaster recovery for offices and remote locations.

product.name: CTERA Drive
product.description: Desktop and mobile software for secure file access, synchronization, sharing, collaboration, and endpoint backup from laptops, tablets, and smartphones.

product.name: CTERA Global File System
product.description: A distributed file system that provides a single namespace for files across offices, endpoints, private clouds, public clouds, and object-storage platforms.

product.name: CTERA Ransom Protect
product.description: A machine-learning-based ransomware protection capability that detects and blocks suspicious file activity and provides an administrative incident-management dashboard.
